$description: Type styles as shipped, copied from the style-guide artifact on 2026-10-30. Source data: do not edit.
source: MNG Android Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/5MyLP13QSt52WGRgXW35ZJ), android-tribpub @ 1cfb069a6, project/tokens.json → type

styles.name: article-headline
styles.usage: Article headline: `ArticleText_Headline_Regular` at 21sp (ArticleText.Headline.Wapo, styles_article.xml:294). PT Serif in 71 markets; Open Sans in DP, SIT, TOD, TTT, VP; Open Sans Condensed Light in NYDN.
styles.sample: City council approves new transit plan

styles.name: article-h1
styles.usage: h1: `Article_Text_Bold` at Article_Header_size1 21sp (articles dimens.xml:106). PT Serif Bold; Open Sans Bold in DP, SIT, TOD, TTT, VP.

styles.name: article-h2
styles.usage: h2: 20sp (Article_Header_size2). Same fonts as article-h1.

styles.name: article-h3
styles.usage: h3: 19sp (Article_Header_size3). Same fonts as article-h1.

styles.name: article-h4
styles.usage: h4: 18sp. h5 is 17sp, h6 16sp.

styles.name: article-body
styles.usage: Article body: `Article_Text_Regular` at 15sp, line spacing x1.2 (ArticleText.Wapo, styles_article.xml:67). PT Serif in 72 markets; Open Sans in DP, SIT, TOD, TTT, VP. Readers can change it: Small / Medium / Large / Extra Large.
styles.sample: Crews worked through the night to reopen the highway after the storm.

styles.name: article-subhead
styles.usage: Article subhead: 14sp (ArticleText.Subhead.Wapo).

styles.name: article-byline
styles.usage: Byline: `Article_Byline_Bold` OpenSans-Bold 13sp, #323232 (CT: OpenSans-SemiBold).

styles.name: article-dateline
styles.usage: Dateline: `Article_Dateline_Bold` OpenSans-Bold 13sp, letter spacing 0.05, #993C3C43 (CT: SemiBold).

styles.name: article-caption
styles.usage: Image caption: `Article_ImageCaption_Regular` OpenSans-Regular 14sp, #787878. Photo credit 13sp.

styles.name: article-image-credit
styles.usage: Image credit: Open Sans Condensed Light (file OpenSans-Regular-Condensed.ttf) 11sp, all caps, letter spacing 0.05, #AFAFAF.

styles.name: article-pullquote
styles.usage: Pull quote: Open Sans Condensed Light 16sp.

styles.name: sf-headline-highlight
styles.usage: Highlight headline base size 21sp (page_headline_highlight_size_base). PageBuilder size multiplies it. `Headline_Font_Highlight`: PT Serif Bold in 71 markets; Open Sans Bold in DP, SIT, TOD, TTT, VP; Open Sans Condensed Bold in NYDN.

styles.name: sf-headline
styles.usage: Normal headline base size 16sp (page_headline_normal_size_base); PageBuilder "normal" = x1.18, about 19sp on phone. `Headline_Font_Normal`, same fonts as sf-headline-highlight.

styles.name: sf-headline-thin
styles.usage: Thin headline base size 15sp. `Headline_Font_Thin`: PT Serif Regular; Open Sans Regular in DP, NYDN, SIT, TOD, TTT, VP.

styles.name: sf-blurb
styles.usage: Story blurb: `Blurb_Font` PT Serif Regular 15sp (homepagestory_blurb_size), line spacing x1.2. All markets.

styles.name: sf-byline
styles.usage: Byline / section / timestamp: `Byline_Font` Open Sans Condensed Bold 13sp, all caps (HomePage_Story_Byline). All markets.

styles.name: sf-label
styles.usage: Story label (kicker): `Label_Font_Normal` OpenSans-Bold 14sp (homepagestory_label_size).

styles.name: nav-label
styles.usage: Bottom-nav tab label: 10sp (NavigationPanelTextAppearance). No font file set, so the system font.

styles.name: section-tab
styles.usage: Section tabs under the top bar: OpenSans SemiBold (Toolbar.Tab). Size is `tabs_text_size`, defined as 12sp in articles and 14sp in notifications.

styles.name: settings-item
styles.usage: Settings row: `Settings_Item_Font` Roboto Regular 14sp in 75 markets; Open Sans in CT, NYDN.

styles.name: settings-category
styles.usage: Settings header: `Settings_Category_Font` Roboto Regular 16sp. CT, NYDN and OS use 14sp; CT uses Open Sans Condensed Bold and NYDN Open Sans Condensed Light.

styles.name: search-headline
styles.usage: Search result headline: `Search_Results_Headline` Spectral Bold 24sp in 71 markets; Open Sans Condensed Bold in DP, NYDN, SIT, TOD, TTT; Open Sans Condensed Light in VP.

styles.name: paywall-heading
styles.usage: Buy-subscription heading: Playfair Display 24 (PaywallHeadingText).

styles.name: paywall-text
styles.usage: Paywall body text: system sans-serif 16sp (PaywallText, maincontroller styles.xml).

styles.name: continue-label
styles.usage: Your News Continue label: OpenSans SemiBold 15sp (17sp at width 400dp+), white.
